name: Global L45 Sorcerer - first-month upgrade target
notes: Upgrade path on top of the median loadout: Rupture Tome +10, Bakarma Guard +10, Aulamus accessories +10, Abyssal Bracelets +10, the best launch titles and five Unique arcana at +5.
Fixed item and enchant values come from the global client item tables (metabot.gg). Random rolls are good but realistic picks from each item's roll pool.

Unique arcana random skill options only roll Sorcerer passives (Robe of Earth, Robe of Flame, Absorb Essence, Grace of Enhancement, Vitality Evaporation, up to +4), so active skills still stop at Lv 14 at level 45.
Deity stats = median profile averages + arcana main stats at +5 (25 each, best variant per slot) + Abyssal Bracelet deity rolls.
